title: Restore AgentGov presentation and documentation consistency

requirement.summary: Keep AgentGov's own product page primary, treat AI Radar only as a bounded origin reference, isolate independent consumers from the public story, and synchronize current documentation with stable 0.2.1 and development source 0.3.0.dev0.

objective.rationale: The public story had split into a separate portfolio design, promoted the reference system before AgentGov's own evidence, and retained v0.1 installation facts after stable 0.2.1 was published.

goal: Synchronize the AgentGov public story, stable installation path, development-source identity, related current documentation, localized guides, and freshness tests without creating runtime coupling to a reference or consumer project.
non_goals: Do not import AI Radar or independent-consumer code, data, infrastructure, credentials, or business workflows.
Do not publish a release, change a consumer workflow, or claim stable 0.3 readiness.
Do not rewrite historical release notes, rehearsals, or dated evidence solely to remove their original version facts.
Do not add autonomous commit, merge, release, or deployment authority.
acceptance_signals: README and public navigation enter the AgentGov product page before the evidence portfolio.
The portfolio uses the AgentGov visual language and presents AI Radar after AgentGov lifecycle and cases without a direct external product call to action.
Current public install surfaces use the published stable 0.2.1 wheel and agentgov commands, while source-only execution remains explicitly labeled.
Public HTML excludes independent consumer project names and has no missing repository-relative links.
AGENTS.md requires affected current documentation, HTML, localization, release facts, and tests to be updated with behavior or version changes.
Focused documentation tests and the complete unit suite pass.
validation_commands: python -m unittest tests.test_public_documentation_freshness tests.test_product_site tests.test_portfolio_page tests.test_user_documentation tests.test_portfolio_docs tests.test_human_adoption_pilot tests.test_report_html -v

items: A stable installation command could accidentally invoke development-source behavior.
A reference case could be presented as runtime or product coupling.
Localized and HTML guidance could drift from the README again without a cross-surface freshness contract.

stop_conditions: Stop if the presentation requires importing runtime code or data from a reference or consumer repository.
Stop if documentation synchronization would require a new release, tag, deployment, or consumer migration.
Stop if visual changes weaken deterministic versus advisory or human-authority boundaries.

decision.rationale: The user explicitly requested the AgentGov-native presentation, full related-document audit and synchronization, and direct commit and push to main.
